citation.title: A clinical study on mechanical ventilation PEEP setting for traumatic ARDS patients guided by esophageal pressure

provenance.quote: The patient with tracheal intubation or tracheotomy accepts the mechanical ventilation
Department of ICU – Intensive Care Unit, Xiamen Third Hospital

the PEEP of the esophageal pressure group was adjusted according to the esophageal pressure, that is, PEEP was first increased from 5 cm H2O to 8 cm H2O, progressively increased by 2 cm H2O, and the maximum PEEP value maintained below 20 cm H2O. Meanwhile, esophageal pressure was measured, and the minimum PEEP value of keeping the end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure was 0–10 cm H2O was selected as the best PEEP
changes in oxygenation index, respiratory mechanics, hemodynamics and inflammatory reaction index were recorded
The data of 23 patients were included in this study
The patients were randomly divided into two groups: the esophageal pressure titration PEEP group (n = 12), and the ARDSNet (PEEP-FiO2 table) titration PEEP group (n = 11)

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS only: all included patients met Berlin ARDS criteria. Obesity unclear: BMI not reported. Timing unclear: grouping time was after hemodynamic stabilization, no interval from intubation or ICU admission specified. PTP target: absolute subtraction PL=Paw-Pes, target end-expiratory PTP 0-10 cmH2O.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap suspected. Trial registration not reported; enrolment dates not reported; single centre Xiamen Third Hospital, China.
unclear_items: Discrepancies between text and Table 2: text reports Ptrans-exp summary as 0.5 ± 0.7 vs -1.1 ± 3.3, while Table 2 baseline is 0.6 ± 0.3 vs -0.3 ± 4.2. Similar discrepancy for CL: text 52.3 ± 26.2 vs 37.5 ± 18.4, table baseline 57 ± 21 vs 37.7 ± 10.1. Recorded table values.
Table 5: IL-6 and IL-8 data are only available at same day and third day; sixth day not reported. Recorded accordingly.
Timing of intervention relative to intubation/ICU admission not reported; only 'grouped after hemodynamics stable'.
Lac at 72h for ARDSNet group reported as 11 ± 0.3, likely typo but recorded as reported.
extraction_flags.general_notes: The paper reports ICU length of stay as 'Live time of ICU' and mechanical ventilation time. No mortality outcome reported.
